media:group.media:title: Para Climbing finals | Fukuoka 2026
media:group.media:description:
The greatest Para Climbing season ever comes to a close in Fukuoka, Japan, as the final stage of the World Climbing Para Series 2026 takes place on 5 and 6 November.
The season finale brings the curtain down on a record-breaking year that saw para climbers compete across five stages, with stops in Salt Lake City, Innsbruck, Laval, Gunsan and, finally, Fukuoka.

media:group.media:title: Para Climbing finals | Gunsan 2026
media:group.media:description:
South Korea welcomes the best para climbers in the world for the second consecutive season, following last year's Para Climbing World Championships in Seoul. This time, the action moves to Gunsan, in North Jeolla Province, for the fourth and penultimate event of the World Climbing Para Series 2026.
Taking place on 29 and 30 October, the competition brings athletes together at the newly renovated Gunsan Climbing Center.
